$description: PETAL Insights typography tokens. Three font families with specific roles: Cormorant Garamond for display, Outfit for body, DM Mono for tags.

display.$value: Cormorant Garamond, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
display.$description: Display headlines, editorial emphasis, key insights. Mix regular and italic in single headlines for editorial rhythm.

body.$description: Body copy, descriptions, UI text. Default weight 300 (light).

mono.$value: DM Mono, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Small caps tags, section labels, technical annotations. Always uppercase, always letter-spaced.

google-fonts-import-url.$description: Single import URL for all three font families. Use this in HTML or @import in CSS.

interactive.$description: Type scale for 800×600 in-article interactive embeds.

static.$description: Type scale for 1080×1440 vertical static graphics (WeChat).

tracking.$description: Letter-spacing values. DM Mono always uses tracking; Cormorant and Outfit rarely do.

headline-italic-mix.$description: Signature move: multi-line headlines mix Cormorant regular and italic, with the italic line(s) in --accent gold. This creates editorial rhythm. Example: 'Catching a / pulmonary embolism / in four stages.' where the middle line is italic gold.

mono-always-uppercase.$description: DM Mono is always uppercase and always letter-spaced. Lowercase mono breaks the visual system.

no-bold-italic.$description: Never bold italic anything. Italic Cormorant at regular weight (400) is the maximum theatrical register the system uses.

outfit-stays-light.$description: Outfit body copy is rarely heavier than 400. The lightness reinforces the editorial register. Heavy weights defeat the system.

no-cormorant-body.$description: Cormorant is a display face. Never use it for body copy or long descriptions.

no-underlines.$description: Never underline text. Use color, weight, or italic for emphasis.
